name: Homework Tutor
summary: An Android study assistant in development for students aged 9–16: work through homework problems step by step with progressive hints and alternative explanations instead of revealing the final answer immediately.

features.title: Step-by-step guided solving
features.description: Guides students through a problem one step at a time instead of revealing the final answer immediately.

features.title: Progressive hints & Explain Differently
features.description: Provides graded hints and alternative explanations for the current step when a student needs another angle.

features.title: Smart Notebook visual identity
features.description: Approved notebook-and-pencil app icon and spiral-notebook UI direction designed for students aged 9–16, with planned photo and text task entry.

features.title: Development status
features.description: Currently in active development with an interactive built-in sample tutoring flow; live AI tutoring, camera task capture, and multi-subject support are not yet production-ready.
